text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: INC-20260315-7 for service `inference-eu-embeddings` — 5xx spike & queue latency increase. Auto-paging to #incidents and #eng-oncall. Details: high 5xx ratio from embedder replicas in eu-central; p50 latency rising from 45ms -> 420ms.

pagerduty: INC-20260315-7 acknowledged by kevin

sre_oncall: I'm on call, looking at metrics and logs now.

kevin: grabbing the bridge — joining Zoom in 1m. quick check: embedding queue length spiking, KV cache evictions up. suspect rolling deploy stress + autoscaler cooldown.

maya: pinging CS. @support_lyn can you triage customer tickets and note impacted customers?

support_lyn: on it — two customers reported search delays, one reported timeouts. I'll post customer IDs to the ticket and notify their CSMs.

kevin: temp mitigation: forced scale to n+2 and enabled fallback-routing for low-tier requests. Running:```bash
kubectl scale deploy/embedder-eu --replicas=6 -n inference
# enable routing override
redwoodctl route set --service embedder-eu --policy fallback-low-tier
```

danya: also recommend prefix KV cache warming and reduce batch size to lower tail latency. I can roll a quick config patch to the runtime to cap max_batch_size=8.

kevin: saw immediate drop in 5xx rate from 10% -> 1.8% after scaling; p50 now ~130ms. still seeing sporadic errors for long-tail requests. continuing to monitor.

pagerduty: note: auto-escalation window suspended — contact on-call directly for handoff.

maya: I'll take primary ownership in 10m while kevin finishes runbook notes. kevin can hand off on the bridge.

kevin: handing off to maya — summary: cause likely autoscaler cooldown + cache thrash after a canary deploy at 11:12 UTC. mitigations applied: scaled replicas, enabled fallback routing, reduced batch size. Logs & runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedder-latency (see section "emergency scale"). :thumbsup:

maya: taking ownership. I'll watch metrics for 30m then start a controlled rollback of the canary if errors persist. @support_lyn please update customers: we applied mitigations, seeing improvement, will confirm 30m stability before full rollback decision.

support_lyn: message sent to impacted customers — they acknowledged and appreciate the quick update.

danya: scheduling an automated eval to run on a small prompt set to ensure output quality didn't regress from fallback routing change.

maya: quick status ping in 15m. if things remain stable I'll coordinate a postmortem and timeline after we close the page.

pagerduty: INC-20260315-7 status: acknowledged -> owner: maya; investigation in progress.

kevin: leaving bridge, all handover notes in the thread and the bridge transcript attached to the incident.

maya: confirmed — continuing monitoring. will file follow-up ticket with root-cause candidates and rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Note: next scheduled check-in snapshot will be posted at +15m.
